headline: US-mediated talks: Israel and Lebanon sign framework peace deal
summary: The agreement aims to end fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah militants, following a conflict that killed over 4,000 people in Lebanon.
details: Israel and Lebanon signed a framework agreement in Washington on Friday, following several days of US-mediated talks to secure an end to fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah militants.
The trilateral document was signed by Lebanese Ambassador Nada Moawad and Israeli counterpart Yechiel Leiter at the US State Department.
The conflict, which began on March 2, triggered Israeli air and ground attacks that killed more than 4,000 people in Lebanon and displaced over a million residents.
While specific terms were not disclosed, Lebanese Ambassador Moawad described the deal as a first step toward restoring Lebanese sovereignty and securing a permanent cessation of hostilities.
Israel's death toll from the hostilities includes at least 32 soldiers and four civilians, while Reuters reports several thousand Hezbollah fighters were killed.
The talks included discussions on Israeli forces handing over some occupied territory in southern Lebanon to Lebanon's military.
Despite the deal, violence has persisted, with Israel reporting strikes against Hezbollah members and issuing evacuation orders in the town of Mansouri.
caption:
Over 4,000 killed and 1 million displaced. Now, a first step toward peace.

Israel and Lebanon signed a framework agreement in Washington on Friday, following several days of US-mediated talks to secure an end to fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah militants.

The trilateral document was signed by Lebanese Ambassador Nada Moawad and Israeli counterpart Yechiel Leiter at the US State Department.

The conflict, which began on March 2, triggered Israeli air and ground attacks that killed more than 4,000 people in Lebanon and displaced over a million residents.

While specific terms were not disclosed, Lebanese Ambassador Moawad described the deal as a first step toward restoring Lebanese sovereignty and securing a permanent cessation of hostilities.

Israel's death toll from the hostilities includes at least 32 soldiers and four civilians, while Reuters reports several thousand Hezbollah fighters were killed.

The talks included discussions on Israeli forces handing over some occupied territory in southern Lebanon to Lebanon's military.

Despite the deal, violence has persisted, with Israel reporting strikes against Hezbollah members and issuing evacuation orders in the town of Mansouri.

headline: College student killed in Faridpur over old enmity
summary: 24-year-old Sumon Sheikh was hacked to death by a group of attackers led by Hussain Sheikh in Alfadanga, Faridpur.
details: Sumon Sheikh, a second-year student of M A Khalek Degree College, was killed on Friday evening in the village of Borobhag in Alfadanga, Faridpur.
The victim was returning home from Kashiani on a motorcycle when a group of attackers, led by Hussain Sheikh, intercepted him near the house of Ukil Sheikh.
The attackers used sharp weapons to hack Sumon severely before fleeing the scene.
Family members rushed him to the Kashiani Upazila Health Complex and later to Faridpur Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared him dead at 8 PM.
Local sources say the attack was fueled by a long-standing dispute between Sumon's family and Hussain Sheikh's family.
Alfadanga Police Station OC Fakir Taijur Rahman stated that the attack was likely due to old enmity and a struggle for local dominance.
Police have visited the scene and launched an operation to arrest the suspects, including the absconding prime suspect Hussain Sheikh.
The body has been sent to the Faridpur Medical College morgue for an autopsy.
caption:
A 24-year-old college student was hacked to death in Faridpur over a long-standing family dispute.

Sumon Sheikh, a second-year student of M A Khalek Degree College, was killed on Friday evening in the village of Borobhag in Alfadanga, Faridpur.

The victim was returning home from Kashiani on a motorcycle when a group of attackers, led by Hussain Sheikh, intercepted him near the house of Ukil Sheikh.

The attackers used sharp weapons to hack Sumon severely before fleeing the scene.

Family members rushed him to the Kashiani Upazila Health Complex and later to Faridpur Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared him dead at 8 PM.

Local sources say the attack was fueled by a long-standing dispute between Sumon's family and Hussain Sheikh's family.

Alfadanga Police Station OC Fakir Taijur Rahman stated that the attack was likely due to old enmity and a struggle for local dominance.

Police have visited the scene and launched an operation to arrest the suspects, including the absconding prime suspect Hussain Sheikh.

The body has been sent to the Faridpur Medical College morgue for an autopsy.
